items.summary: zacodil解释NEAR后量子选格签名、以太坊选哈希签名的原因：NEAR的chain signatures靠派生密钥控制BTC、ETH、SOL地址，换用不支持派生的方案会导致旧密钥下的资产无人能签名。
items.author: zacodil
items.new_information: chain signatures依赖密钥派生

evidence.quote: For its post-quantum future NEAR picked lattice signatures. Ethereum picked a different family, hash-based signatures. Here is, in plain words, why this is not a matter of taste but a consequence of what each chain has to protect.

A lattice signature keeps algebraic structure. That structure is what lets you do things with keys: derive one public key from another without ever touching the private one, or split a key between parties and sign together. It is a slightly bigger assumption in exchange for keys you can build on.

NEAR cannot give that up. Chain signatures let a NEAR account control addresses on Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana through derived keys, and the assets sit on those chains under those keys. Move to a scheme with no derivation and the derived keys vanish. The Bitcoin side does not know the scheme changed, so the funds behind the old key stay where they are, with
nobody able to sign for them.

items.summary: haenko21对比SOL与NEAR现货ETF的上线时点：BSOL上线时，SOL已从周期低点涨约24倍且链上活跃见顶；NRR上线时，NEAR仅涨约5倍，较2022年高点仍低约75%，NEAR Intents用量仍在创新高。NRR首日流入3550万美元，相对约65亿美元市值影响更大。作者称ETF不是底部保证。
items.author: haenko21
items.new_information: NRR首日流入3550万美元，作者称处于周期早段

evidence.quote: the easy take is: $SOL sold off after its ETF, so NEAR is next. but the ETFs arrived at completely different points in the cycle. when BSOL launched in October 2025, SOL was ~$195 and the crowd that drove the run was already leaving. daily users on Solana DEXs had peaked at 4.8m in January and fallen below 800k by September. SOL is ~$120 today.

NRR launched last week with NEAR near $5, still ~75% below its 2022 high, while usage is moving the other way. NEAR Intents did $300m+ in a single day on Sept 18, roughly three quarters of its entire July 2025 volume, and September was its best fee month of the year.

then there are the flows. NRR pulled in $35.5m on day one. BSOL did more in absolute dollars, but relative to the underlying asset's market cap, NRR's debut was much bigger. $35m hitting a ~$6.5b asset is a very different force than ETF flows hitting a ~$100b one.

so the comparison looks backwards to me: Solana's ETF arrived after the run, as activity was fading and holders had gains to sell. NEAR's ETF is arriving while usage is still making new highs and a new source of structural demand is entering. that doesn't mean NEAR can't pull back, an ETF isn't a floor, but this isn't the Solana setup repeating.

items.new_information: 标普推出金库风险评估框架及评级符号，行业存款100亿美元

evidence.quote: 吴说获悉，标普全球评级（S&P Global Ratings）发布针对链上借贷 Vault 的风险评估体系 Vault Risk Assessment（VRA），适用于向以加密资产或代币化 RWA 为抵押品的区块链借贷市场提供流动性的 Vault。VRA 将综合评估底层资产信用风险、协议及区块链风险、Vault 管理方风险和流动性等因素，并采用 AAA(v) 等评级符号，其中 AAA(v) 代表最低风险。标普强调，VRA 并非传统信用评级，也不评价 Vault 收益率或保证其信用质量。
THE BLOCK: S&P Global Ratings has launched a new risk assessment framework for onchain lending vaults as deposits in the sector reach $10 billion, up from $1.5 billion two years ago.
The framework will assess credit, liquidity, curator, blockchain, protocol, security, and governance risks, with initial vault assessments to follow.
据 The Block 报道，标普全球评级已推出面向链上借贷金库的新风险评估框架。报道称，该领域存款规模已达 100 亿美元，两年前为 15 亿美元。
该框架将评估信用、流动性、管理人、区块链、协议、安全与治理风险，首批金库评估将随后公布。
🚨 NEW: S&P Global Ratings rolls out a Vault Risk Assessment framework to evaluate the risks of onchain digital asset lending vaults, which now hold $10B in deposits. https://t.co/UQFSHRnjNc

evidence.quote: Binance to Block Brazil Cross-Border Crypto Transfers From Nov. 1 Without Purpose and Counterparty Details

Binance will require Brazilian users to disclose the purpose and counterparty of cross-border crypto transfers from Nov. 1, CryptoSlate reported. Withdrawals cannot be submitted until the questionnaire is completed. Deposits may stay pending and, in some cases, be returned if the information is missing. Transfers between Brazilian residents are unaffected.

Binance will report the transactions monthly to Brazil’s central bank under Resolution BCB No. 521/2025. Transfers of up to $50,000 use a 10-purpose list; larger ones require one of 96 classifications. Some transfers are capped at $100,000 if the counterparty is not authorized in Brazil’s FX market.

evidence.quote: @jumperapp might become an interesting case study here. There has been a lot of vocal pushback since it started charging fees, including from DeFi users who aren't just airdrop farmers.

Yesterday Jumper processed just $2.32M in volume, ~30% below the day fees were announced and its second-lowest daily volume of 2026. It's way too early to attribute that to fees, but this is exactly what makes Jumper worth watching. Complaining about fees isn't necessarily the same as being elastic to them, but we will get to measure it.

Morpho is obviously a different product and market, but eventually it faces some version of the same question: how much value can you start capturing before the growth you spent years subsidizing starts going somewhere else?

items.summary: brucexu_eth称，获Coinbase Ventures与Multicoin投资200万美元的p2p.me与zkp2p逻辑一致，但改为按单代付：据其理解，用户质押USDC，由流动性提供商代付法币后领取。他认为代付业务易与灰黑产结合。
items.author: lurenbian
items.new_information: 获200万美元投资，被质疑代付模式易被灰产利用

evidence.quote: 昨天注意到 @cbventures @multicoin 投资200万美元的这个 p2p[.]me 背后的产品逻辑和 zkp2p 完全一致。但不同于直接出入金，变成了按单、按消费结算。@ConstantinGao 锐评：“p2p[.]me 更像闲鱼/淘宝中的代付服务”，而现在的代付产业一直是和灰黑产高度绑定的。
大体上应该是用户提交一个付款需求（买咖啡/麦当劳），然后向平台质押相应数额的 USDC。随后p2p[.]me 将付款需求发布在他们的流动性提供商渠道中，最后提供商直接帮用户付法币并凭付款凭证领取用户质押的 USDC。
但最后 go to market ，真正和黑灰产结合就要看这些老逼登们的了。而这种原生的 p2p 加 zk 证明结合的底层架构即使不成熟不完美但肯定还是能在监管上法律上给灰产大哥们创造更多短期腾挪空间的。
